objective: Give Shreeji Furniture a catalogue-ready version of its own showroom photograph with the staff member in the background gone and nothing else touched.
hard_constraints: the sofa, its colour and its position do not change — 'Sofa, uska colour, uski position ... kuch bhi change nahi hona chahiye'
the room's lighting does not change — 'room ki lighting'
the vacated area is filled with the same wall and floor that surround it — 'Jo jagah khaali ho wahan wahi wall aur floor aa jaana chahiye'
no text and no logo is added — 'Koi text ya logo mat daalna'
acceptance_statements: REJECT if any person, or part of a person, remains anywhere in the picture.
ACCEPT only if the sofa has the same outline, colour and position in the frame as in the supplied photograph when the two are flicked side by side.
REJECT if the lighting direction or the overall brightness of the room has changed.
REJECT if any lettering or logo appears anywhere.

composition.attention_order: 1st read stays the sofa; the filled background introduces no new cue that competes with it
composition.placement_zone: as supplied — no re-crop, no re-framing

materials_and_light.surface_finish_per_key_object: sofa: matte woven fabric, unchanged; floor: semi-gloss tile, unchanged; wall: matte paint, unchanged
materials_and_light.implied_light_source: preserved as supplied — the room's existing single direction must survive into the filled area, and no shadow there may contradict it
materials_and_light.doctrine_note: the supplied photograph is the creative decision; finish, angle and key level are not re-decided on an edit
